title: Sega Flash Vol. 6
overview:
Sega Flash Vol. 6 is a free European demo disc from Sega, given away in the UK with Sega Saturn Magazine. It collects playable demos and previews of Saturn games.

Playable demos:
- Sega Worldwide Soccer '98 Club Edition
- Steep Slope Sliders
- Sega Touring Car Championship

Non-playable previews:
- Enemy Zero
- Panzer Dragoon Saga
- The Lost World: Jurassic Park
- NBA Action 98
- Sonic R
